XCAPITOLO.Corpo:
Reliability level key

* low level : Reported by a garage mechanic; fault case not recorded by the manufacturer.

** medium level : Widespread occurrence of the fault, confirmed by service technicians and independent repairers.

*** high level : Confirmed fault, with a high degree of ‘recurrence’ reported by the manufacturer.

• System: Electronics

  • Device: Main battery

  • Fault: Occasionally, during the first cold start, the engine fails to start and the immobiliser warning light comes on. After resetting the instrument cluster, the engine starts normally.

  • Errors detected by the self-diagnostic system: - -

  • Cause: Faulty main battery

• Action: Check the condition and correct operation of the battery and, if necessary, replace it

  • Procedure: - -

  • Notes: - -
